memory: Neoprene gasket removes microslip but added compliance and extruded ~1.6 N. Adding a 1.5 mm stainless backing ring preserved slip suppression up to ~1.9 N, restored most flange stiffness and energy-independence, but extrusion/failure recurs ~1.95–2.0 N. Current aim: raise extrusion threshold without reintroducing microslip.
openQuestion: If I double backing-ring thickness to 3.0 mm, will extrusion threshold exceed 2.0 N without returning microslip?
